summary: gateway-prep-stages gains its OpenClaw 2026.10.9 variant (packages map of the same manifest, same owner): the 2026.9.6 plugin-tools checkpoints unchanged on openclaw-tools-CSSYZDKR and tools-DQdRObqo, the eight system-prompt sub-spans moved to attempt-system-prompt-prepare-ChKsbjSh where setup.prepStages is optional. The 2026.10.9 Gateway startup triage is documented; no setting is applied.
reason: S24 isolated upgrade rehearsal (01/11): gateway-prep-stages refused 2026.10.9 (unsupported_package_version). The diagnostic gap it fills still exists in npm openclaw@2026.10.9 (no plugin-tools or system-prompt sub-stages upstream). The rehearsal also showed an automatic startup triage that can start a model turn; it is described with its guards, and the same mechanism is already present in 2026.9.6.

evidence: Diagnostic compatibility set applied only explicitly by root; no startup, sync or deploy hook.

limitations: Module hashes are those of npm openclaw@2026.10.9; confirmation on the S24 isolated candidate remains before any application.

Startup triage: no dedicated setting exists in 2026.10.9; OPENCLAW_SUPERVISOR_MODE=external, OPENCLAW_SHELL=exec and CODEX_THREAD_ID all have other meanings, and 2026.9.6 honours the same guard, so nothing is set in gateway-start.sh; decision and S24 acceptance are pending.
rollback: Revert this commit: the 2026.9.6 set is byte-identical and nothing applies this set automatically; a manual 2026.10.9 application is undone with --patch-set gateway-prep-stages --rollback.
